title: Zambia United Capital 300,000 t/y Fertilizer Project
summary: Tongyang was substantially involved in the Zambia United Capital 300,000 t/y Fertilizer Project, working with China Wuhuan Engineering Co., Ltd. on the engineering, fabrication and delivery of storage tank equipment.
body:
Project Background

The Zambia United Capital 300,000 t/y Fertilizer Project is an overseas fertilizer industry project involving China Wuhuan Engineering Co., Ltd.

Tongyang's Role & Scope of Involvement

Tongyang participated in the project as an equipment manufacturing partner, undertaking substantial involvement in the engineering, fabrication and delivery of storage tank equipment.

The scope covered project-specific storage tank equipment manufacturing and delivery in coordination with China Wuhuan Engineering Co., Ltd.

This project represents Tongyang's participation in an overseas fertilizer industry project and demonstrates its capabilities in customized industrial storage equipment manufacturing for large-scale chemical and fertilizer facilities.
